method: Static audit of committed repository content only. No external registry, CRA, PSPC, FedRAMP or SAM lookup was performed.

claims.claim: ClearGlass Inc. is incorporated in Ontario
evidence: index.html assurance strip states "Incorporated in Ontario, Canada". No Certificate of Incorporation, OCN or Ontario Business Registry record exists in the repository.
limitations: Contradicted in-repo: operations/ontario-incorporation-handoff.html instructs the founder to 'Capture the resulting Ontario Corporation Number (OCN) and the issued Certificate of Incorporation' (future tense) and not to sign contracts in the corporate name 'until the Ontario Certificate of Incorporation has been issued'.
claims.required_next_action: Obtain the Ontario Certificate of Incorporation and Business Registry profile; until then remove or qualify the homepage assurance badge.

evidence: No OCN value appears anywhere. The term occurs only in a handoff workflow describing how to obtain one.
limitations: An incorporation workflow is a plan, not an incorporation record.
claims.required_next_action: Record the OCN from the Ontario Business Registry once issued.

evidence: No certificate artifact in the repository. PDFs present are a Coursera course certificate, a domain ownership letter, a Cloudflare domain certificate and the Institute founding kit.
limitations: No corporate registry document of any kind is committed.
claims.required_next_action: Store the issued certificate in a controlled evidence folder and reference it here.

evidence: 'registered office' appears only in templates and planning text, never as a filed address tied to a corporation number.
limitations: Template language only.
claims.required_next_action: Record the registered office as filed.

evidence: Only unexecuted director-consent templates exist.
limitations: Template contains placeholder '[Full Legal Name]'.
claims.required_next_action: Record directors from the filed Initial Return.

claims.claim: ClearGlass Institute is an ONCA not-for-profit corporation
evidence: Founding kit describes it as a "Proposed ONCA Corp" and directors consent "upon incorporation" — pre-incorporation planning.
limitations: A separate repository ClearGlassInc/ClearGlass-Institute- exists but was not audited here.
claims.required_next_action: Obtain the ONCA Certificate of Incorporation before any nonprofit status is stated publicly.

claims.claim: ClearGlass Institute is a registered charity
evidence: The kit states: "It is not a registered charity with the Canada Revenue Agency and cannot issue official donation receipts for income tax purposes at this time."
limitations: This disclaimer is accurate and should be preserved verbatim.
claims.required_next_action: No action. Keep this disclaimer wherever donations are discussed.

evidence: Appears only as a future task: "Apply for the CRA Business Number, register for GST/HST".
limitations: No BN value is present, and none should be published once obtained without a confidentiality review.
claims.required_next_action: Record BN issuance privately; do not publish the number itself.

evidence: Referenced as a prerequisite still to be completed for supplier registration.
limitations: Listed under 'Requires PBN, GST/HST number' — a requirement, not a holding.
claims.required_next_action: Complete registration before invoicing tax.

evidence: government.html shows badges "FedRAMP READY" and "FedRAMP Authorization"; the body text says only "aligned to FedRAMP Moderate baselines". No package ID, authorization status or sponsoring agency.
limitations: Alignment to a baseline is not an authorization. 'FedRAMP Ready' is itself a designation issued through the FedRAMP PMO and is not evidenced.
claims.required_next_action: Remove the authorization/ready badges or replace with 'designed against FedRAMP Moderate baselines (not authorized)'.

evidence: Badge reads "CMMC LEVEL 2"; body says "practices implemented". No C3PAO, assessment record or SPRS score.
limitations: Implementing practices is not certification.
claims.required_next_action: Qualify as 'CMMC L2 practices implemented; not assessed or certified'.

evidence: Badge reads "SOC 2 TYPE II"; body says "SOC 2 Type II Readiness". No report, auditor, period or scope.
limitations: Readiness is not an audited report.
claims.required_next_action: Display as 'SOC 2 Type II readiness' only, with no badge implying a completed report.

evidence: government.html claims platforms "aligned to CCCS Security Controls Catalogue (ITSG-33)". Self-description, no CCCS assessment.
limitations: CCCS did not assess or endorse anything evidenced here.
claims.required_next_action: Keep the word 'aligned'; never imply CCCS assessment or endorsement.

evidence: ITAR is referenced widely in generated planning documents; no DDTC registration code or record exists.
limitations: Mentions are aspirational or contextual.
claims.required_next_action: Remove ITAR from capability badges unless DDTC-registered.

claims.claim: Listed under PSPC ProServices Supply Arrangement, SIN 3.3
evidence: government.html states: "ProServices - SIN 3.3 (Cybersecurity) Listed under PSPC ProServices Supply Arrangement - SIN 3.3 IT Security". The same repository states federal supplier registrations are still outstanding.
limitations: Direct internal contradiction: operations/procurement-readiness.html lists 'PENDING - FOUNDER Federal supplier registrations - SRI, SAP Ariba, Integrity Declaration', and federal-supplier-handoff.html is titled 'Submit federal supplier registrations' with status 'PENDING - CREDENTIALS'.
A ProServices listing would require a qualified supply arrangement holder record; none is evidenced.
claims.required_next_action: HIGHEST PRIORITY: replace the affirmative listing statement with 'Procurement status: NOT VERIFIED - supply arrangement not held.'

evidence: Registration is described as an action still to be performed, requiring founder authentication and an Integrity Declaration.
limitations: Explicitly PENDING in the handoff.
claims.required_next_action: State as 'registration in progress' or omit.

evidence: Referenced as a pathway; no UEI, CAGE code or SAM record.
limitations: No identifiers of any kind.
claims.required_next_action: Omit until a UEI/CAGE is issued.

evidence: No award notice, solicitation number, contract number, standing offer or task authorization exists anywhere in the repository.
limitations: 'procurement-ready' and 'structured for rapid award' are forward-looking, not awards.
claims.required_next_action: Do not state or imply any government customer.

evidence: 'production deployment' appears in specs, plans and CI documentation. No customer, contract or authenticated production evidence.
limitations: Sophisticated source code is not evidence of a production customer deployment.
claims.required_next_action: Classify products as code/prototype unless a customer record exists.

evidence: Mentioned in policy and IP-assignment language, not as a delivered report.
limitations: No scope, tester or report.
claims.required_next_action: Do not claim testing without a report.

evidence: Only an offer/sales kit exists: "Offer Name: ClearGlass 24-Hour Website & GitHub Deployment Rescue", with outreach email templates.
limitations: Capability and offer are documented; no invoice, contract, customer letter or engagement record.
The kit does carry an accurate non-affiliation disclaimer, which should be preserved.
claims.required_next_action: State as an offered service, never as completed engagements.

claims.claim: Founder/director identity linkage for Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
evidence: The name appears in ~119 repository files as author/founder attribution. No authoritative corporate director record links this identity to a registered corporation.
limitations: Repository self-attribution is not an authoritative identity record.
Name similarity must not be used to merge identities with other individuals.
claims.required_next_action: Establish linkage only from the Ontario director record once incorporated.

evidence: No such directory exists in this repository. ClearGlassInc/clearglass-network-overdrive is a separate repository (public, last pushed 2026-08-10).
limitations: Not audited here; no conclusion is drawn about its code or any engagement.
claims.required_next_action: Audit separately before describing it as a product or service.
